# lib/mcp23x17 module

MCP23017 and MCP23S17 16-bit I/O expander HAL module on lib/bus. This page is the reference for the `lib/mcp23x17` HAL module, for firmware authors choosing and wiring it in.

## Use it

The manifest lists one example program per family, plus peer programs for extra transports where the driver has them. Build one with the repository build driver (--example names a peer), or read it as the working starting point for your own firmware.

| Family | Example | Source |
|---|---|---|
| PIC16F87XA | `mcp23x17` | [`lib/mcp23x17/examples/example_mcp23x17_target.c`](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/blob/master/lib/mcp23x17/examples/example_mcp23x17_target.c) |
| PIC16F88X | `mcp23x17` | [`lib/mcp23x17/examples/example_mcp23x17_target.c`](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/blob/master/lib/mcp23x17/examples/example_mcp23x17_target.c) |
| PIC18Fxx5x | `mcp23x17` | [`lib/mcp23x17/examples/example_mcp23x17_target.c`](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/blob/master/lib/mcp23x17/examples/example_mcp23x17_target.c) |

## API

The API is documented next to the code, in the [`lib/mcp23x17` directory](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/tree/master/lib/mcp23x17). This page does not restate it. The manifest carries no function list, so no API table is generated here yet.

## Limits

- Not built for PIC16F872. Reason: flash: the lib/bus dependency does not fit 2K CODE.
- Not built for PIC16F870, PIC16F871. Reason: no SSP peripheral on this cut-down.
